senses.definition: To provide an impetus for motion or physical action; to cause to move in a certain direction; to drive or push forward.
senses.example: When it had advanced from the wood, it hopped much after the fashion of a kangaroo, using its hind feet and tail to propel it, and when it stood erect, it sat upon its tail.

senses.definition: To provide an impetus for nonphysical change; to cause to arrive to a certain situation or result.
senses.example: I can discern your nature and see that even without any arguments (logoi) from me it will propel you to what you say you are drawn towards,
